nodes.label: Data Constraints and Retention
nodes.rationale: Historical transactions are protected through unique constraints, non-cascading deletion, snapshots, and five-year private payment-proof retention.

nodes.label: Historical Transaction Snapshots
nodes.rationale: Snapshots keep historical orders and invoices stable when POS masters, store profiles, prices, addresses, or tax configuration change.

nodes.label: Minimal MVP Data Decisions
nodes.rationale: The model deliberately omits granular permissions, Biteship booking entities, split shipments, loyalty tables, and report aggregates until requirements or production measurements justify them.

nodes.label: Ponytail Lazy Senior Mode
nodes.rationale: Stop at the first solution rung that works and write only the minimum correct code.

nodes.label: Root-Cause Bug Fix
nodes.source_location: Bug fix = root cause, not symptom
nodes.rationale: Trace callers and fix the shared cause once.

nodes.label: Minimal Runnable Check
nodes.rationale: Non-trivial logic leaves one small runnable check.

nodes.label: Cheerful Gadget Retail Visual Direction
nodes.rationale: Use yellow-led gadget-retail branding, not cold corporate or generic AI styling.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith Domain Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Keep business logic in the owning domain and share only through explicit APIs.

nodes.label: BRD FRD SRS MVP Review Chain
nodes.norm_label: brd frd srs mvp review chain

nodes.label: Hybrid Agile-Waterfall Delivery
nodes.rationale: Agile governs iteration while stage gates govern baseline, UAT, release readiness, and go-live.

nodes.label: Five-Layer UI Architecture
nodes.rationale: Separate tokens, primitives, shared wrappers, business components, and page screens.

nodes.label: Flux Internal Custom Storefront Hybrid Commerce
nodes.rationale: Use Flux First internally, custom brand UI publicly, and hybrid composition for commerce screens.
nodes.norm_label: flux internal custom storefront hybrid commerce

nodes.label: SSR-First Frontend Performance
nodes.rationale: Keep Blade/Livewire SSR, minimize JavaScript, and discipline images, lists, and state for shared hosting.

nodes.label: Laravel Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: One codebase fits the initial domain and load while preserving strong transactional consistency.

nodes.label: Non-Production Sample Data Adapter
nodes.rationale: Reuse the POS import/upsert contract so sample data does not create a parallel transaction model.
